## Summary

Describe the problem and the outcome of this change.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any evidence limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to an issue or design discussion when appropriate.
- [ ] Tests and documentation are added or updated where relevant.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or unsanitized runtime payloads are included.
- [ ] Security and side-effect implications are described.
- [ ] Commits include DCO sign-off (`git commit --signoff`).
